opening.argument: The presentation ties entry to paid OneCoin packages, stating that viewers can start with packages ranging from “a hundred” to “five thousand euros,” with higher payments producing larger token allocations. It then presents recruitment as an income method: “if you refer somebody you're gonna get a commission,” including a $500 bonus when another participant buys the Tycoon package. The account-splitting material adds that “people's accounts double” every 40 to 60 days, while the projections assign future value to the coin over 52 weeks. Against that backdrop, the closing instruction to “partner with our team today” creates pressure to act immediately, while delay is associated with the possibility of higher coin prices. The available evidence does not establish whether these projected returns or payouts occurred.
